title: A 3D genome atlas of human tonsil and the role of loop extrusion in B cell somatic hypermutation.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: Zenodo record 10.5281/zenodo.19959235 (CC-BY-4.0, open): 6 files, DropletHiC_analyzed_data.zip 58.0 GB, Codes.zip 4.0 GB, Sequencing_analyzed_bigWig_data.zip 4.7 GB, Imaging_analyzed_data.zip 2.6 GB. Listed zip contents via ranged reads of the central directory: imaging zip has 412 entries, all MATLAB .mat structs (tonsil DNA-MERFISH, a multiplexed imaging method, replicates Rep1-Rep5; per-replicate CellListRNA .mat ~0.77-0.85 GB each plus ~50 chromosome-FOV .mat files of 3-60 MB); Droplet Hi-C (single-cell chromosome-contact sequencing) zip holds 4 sc.pairs.gz files of 7.6-20.8 GB and 7 per-cell-type .mcool files (0.11-0.83 GB); bigWig zip holds 3C-HTGTS and CUT&RUN signal tracks. Read note.txt: Group1 = T cells, Groups 2-3 subclustered into GCBC, NBC, MBC, PC (germinal-centre, naive, memory B cells, plasma cells). BioProject PRJNA1460889 exists (raw reads only).
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: Abstract only (Europe PMC full text returned HTTP 500; supplement not retrievable). Number of cells, per-cell labels, and how cell types were assigned are not verified; no .mat file content was opened (all exceed the 50 MB cap except small chromosome FOV files, which hold traces not labels).

a1_downloadable.note: Open Zenodo record, CC-BY-4.0, no login; verified file listing and sizes.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: No tabular label anywhere: the only candidate label (per-cell type from RNA imaging, or Droplet Hi-C cluster) sits inside ~0.8 GB MATLAB structs or must be reconstructed from 20 GB per-cell pairs files; checked listings, not contents.

a3_inputs_present.note: Inputs (chromatin traces, contact pairs) are present as processed files, not accessions; verified by listing.

a4_units_stated.note: Not checkable without opening the .mat structs; no README or column documentation found in the zips.

a5_enough_rows.note: Cell count not verified; a tonsil atlas likely has thousands of cells, but this is from the abstract only.

a6_fits_laptop.working_set: ~2.6 GB compressed MATLAB imaging (likely >5 GB uncompressed) or 7.6-20.8 GB per Droplet Hi-C pairs file
a6_fits_laptop.note: Any per-cell table needs the multi-GB zips; mcools are per-cell-type aggregates (only 7 'rows').

a7_counts_match_paper.note: Could not compare: paper full text unavailable and file contents unopened.

a8_label_provenance.note: Cell types would come from clustering of RNA or contact profiles; RNA-based labels in imaging would be independent of DNA traces, but this is unverified.

backbone.name: None standard for single-cell 3D genome data (Higashi-style models exist but not a freeze-and-head backbone)

honest_claim_h3: Would at best claim that chromatin traces from five tonsil replicates distinguish B cell states in this one imaging study; not reached because no label table could be verified.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use the 3D folding of chromosomes in single tonsil cells to predict each cell's type or germinal-centre zone.
plain_idea.train_on: Per-cell chromosome traces from DNA imaging (5 tonsil replicates) or per-cell contact maps; number of cells unknown.
plain_idea.predict: The cell's type (naive, germinal-centre, memory B cell, plasma cell, T cell) assigned from RNA imaging in the same cell or from clustering.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Would show how much immune-cell identity is written in genome folding, but the data are multi-GB MATLAB structs with no label table.

ml_idea: Classify tonsil cell type / germinal-centre zone from single-cell chromatin traces (DNA-MERFISH) with RNA-derived labels; abandoned at Part A.

effort.compute_note: Not estimated; only file listings seen. Per-replicate cell lists alone are ~0.8 GB .mat each.
effort.cheapest_killing_check: Download one replicate's CellListRNA .mat (0.85 GB, over cap) and check whether it holds a per-cell type column and how many cells it has.

verdict_reason: Open on Zenodo but only as multi-GB MATLAB structs and 8-21 GB contact-pairs files; no per-cell label table exists (A2), the working set is beyond the laptop/download cap (A6), and units and counts are unverifiable (A4, A7).
